text:
Marta P.: Quick heads-up: after the int8 rollout for solace-v1 we got a reproducible drop on the hk_vertical_emoji_roundtrip set. BLEU delta ~ -5.1 on the nightly sweep.

eval-bot: Regression alert: solace-v1 (int8) | hk_vertical_emoji_roundtrip | BLEU -5.1 | 2026-03-22T09:12Z. See: https://console.redwood/ops/regressions/INF-9999

Cheng Li: Can you paste the minimal repro + quant config and a token id dump?

Marta P.: Repro (run from evals/cli):
```bash
PYTHONPATH=. python -m evals.run --model solace-v1 --quant int8 --suite hk_vertical_emoji_roundtrip --batch 8 --seed 42
```
Sample raw input: "\u9999\u6e2f\ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0\n\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u97f3"
Gold detok: "\u9999\u6e2f \ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0\n\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u97f3"
solace-v1 int8 detok example: "\u9999\u6e2f\u200b\ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0\n\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u200b\u97f3"  <-- unexpected U+200B around emoji/particle

Ravi Kumar: That looks like an inserted ZWSP (U+200B). Does tokenizer.encode output an extra id?

Marta P.: Token id dumps (same tokenizer binary):
```
# gold encode ->
[987, 2048, 9, 4411]
# solace-v1 float32 run ->
[987, 2048, 9, 4411]
# solace-v1 int8 observed ->
[987, 2048, 9, 77, 4411]
# id 77 maps to a control/unprintable (likely ZWSP)
```
This behavior reproduces with the offline tokenizer on my laptop (so not just runtime decode).

Cheng Li: Any recent merges touching tokenizer normalizer or merge tables? Also infra rolled `kv-fusion-3` kernels on 2026-03-21 per eng-infra channel.

Marta P.: Tokenizer repo shows only a docstring tweak last week. However a CI job updated the tokenizer wheel build process (normalization flags changed?) on 03/20. I'm bisecting the tokenizer wheel vs upstream wheel now.

Ravi Kumar: If the token id is present pre-model then quantization shouldn't create it, but int8 beam scoring might prefer outputs that include it. So quantization amplifies the user-visible regression. Good to separate two fixes: tokenizer normalization fix upstream + guardrail in eval infra.

Cheng Li: Can you run the same sample with q8 and fp32 to confirm magnitude? Also tag tokenizer owners: @tokenizer-team.

Marta P.: q8/fp32 encode outputs: both q8 and fp32 give the correct id sequence (no 77). The int8 tokenizer binary (packaged in the int8 runtime image) is the one showing 77. So the bug is likely in the packaged wheel used by int8 images. Bisecting image layers now.

eval-bot: Created issue INF-9999 for hk_vertical_emoji_roundtrip regression and linked nightly results.

Marta P.: Short-term mitigation: added a post-detok sanitizer in the eval harness: text = re.sub('\\u200B', '', text). Deployed to staging so smoke runs ignore ZWSP while we triage. PR: https://phabricator.redwood/r/PR-5643

Ravi Kumar: Strong preference to fix tokenizer upstream (normalize/remove ZWSP in pre-tokenize phase). Post-detok hack is fine as temporary. Also please add an explicit smoke test that verifies no ZWSPs are introduced for hk_vertical_emoji_roundtrip.

Cheng Li: Freezing kernel and image rollouts until bisect completes. I'll reach out to infra to see which image layer bumped the tokenizer wheel.

Marta P.: Will follow up with exact offending wheel version and delta once bisect finishes. For now: rollback int8 image to previous build in canary and keep staging sanitizer. Thanks all. :pray:

Ravi Kumar: Thanks, appreciate the fast triage. :thumbsup:

Marta P.: Attached example payload and encoder logs to INF-9999 for debugging (tokenizer dump + image layer diff).
